reply: Thank you for telling us that you received emails about a new account and cards you never applied for, being sent to an address that is not yours. We understand your concern about identity theft. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please do not reply to the emails with personal details; contact the company only through its official website number, and review your credit reports for any accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern that in-store purchases with your debit card appear in your online retailer account, and what this may mean for your personal information. We understand why you want to know how this happens. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please note the dates of the purchases you saw linked, and review the privacy settings and saved payment methods on the retailer account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid off your store card in full, but new interest was charged because the payment was not posted until days after it was received. We understand why you feel the interest should not apply. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the posting date. Please keep proof of the date the payment was received and your statement showing the new interest. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a $490.00 collection account you do not recognize appears on your credit report, and that you believe it comes from identity theft. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. You can ask the collector in writing for the validation details of the debt, and keep copies of your requests and your identity theft report. Please do not share full account numbers by email. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your payment was applied to your 0% balance transfer instead of your higher-rate purchase balance, and that the conditional credits were later removed. We understand your concern about how payments are allocated. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep the statements showing the balances and payment, and review the payment allocation terms in your cardholder agreement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your store card credit limit was lowered from $5,300.00 to $3,200.00 without notice of the reason. We understand how this affects your credit use. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Card issuers can reduce credit limits, but you can ask in writing for the reason, and keeping your use of available credit low can help. Please keep the notice you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a card account you did not open is on your credit reports, and that your disputes have not removed it. We understand how damaging this is to your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep copies of your earlier disputes, your Federal Trade Commission report and any supporting documents, and ask in writing for the account opening records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a security deposit was taken from your checking account for a secured card, and that the application was then declined without the deposit being returned. We understand how frustrating the wait has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the return of the deposit. Please keep your bank statement showing the debit and the decline email. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you met the spending requirement for the new card bonus but received fewer miles than the offer advertised when you applied. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the terms of the offer at the time of your application. Please keep the dated screenshots of the offer and a record of your calls. These will help the review compare the offer to the miles credited. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your credit card and identity were stolen, and that more charges were made even after the card number was changed. We are sorry this is happening. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please review your statements and report any further charges you did not make by phone and in writing right away, and keep a copy of your fraud alert. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $100.00 cash payment you made at the store was never posted to your account, and that late payments have been reported since. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the payment history. Please keep any receipt or record of the store visit and the date, and send a written dispute about the missing payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $420.00 dispute about a plumbing service was denied twice, and that you disagree with the reasons given. We understand how difficult it is to prove what was said. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep any written messages with the service company and your dispute letters, and ask in writing what further evidence would be considered. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were asked to provide your tax transcript to verify your income or your card account would be closed. We understand why this request felt intrusive. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including whether other forms of income proof can be accepted. Please keep the request letter and a note of what you were told by phone. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a replacement card was sent to an old address and used for a $1,300.00 charge you did not make. We understand your concern after providing your police report and call logs. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep copies of everything you sent and the date you sent it, and review your cardholder agreement for your rights on unauthorized charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card balance has stayed at about $1,400.00 for over a year and a half despite monthly payments and no new charges. We understand why this is confusing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Your statement shows how much interest is charged each month and how long it takes to pay off the balance at the minimum payment; please keep your recent statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a fraudulent account remains on your credit report and has been sent to collections, despite earlier complaints. We understand how stressful the collection calls are. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please send the collector a written dispute and keep copies of the fraud documents you received from the other bank. Disputed debts are marked on credit reports while they are investigated. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your future travel credit can only be redeemed by phone, and that the quoted price is higher than the price listed online. We understand your concern about the value of the credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the redemption terms. Please keep screenshots of the listed fare with the date, and any written terms you received with the credit. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that someone accessed your rewards account and used your points for gift cards, and that you did not receive them. We understand your concerns about how this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including the points. Please keep your report reference, change your passwords, and do not share codes or details with anyone who contacts you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you opened a store card for a promotional financing offer, and that an annual fee and interest appeared that you were not told about. We understand your frustration after the late delivery as well. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep the paperwork you signed and your statements, and check how the promotional terms work, because deferred interest plans have specific rules. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card account was restricted even though your payments have cleared, and that you were asked again for bank account details. We understand your concern about sharing that information. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep the list of your cleared payments and ask in writing what is still needed to lift the restriction. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you twice received a gift card code that had already been used, after redeeming your rewards points. We are sorry for the embarrassment this caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the rewards team, including your request to cancel the gift card and restore the points. Please keep the emails with both codes and a note of your calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you received a credit card you never applied for and a verification form for an employer you never worked for. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please do not use the card, keep the letters you received, and review your credit reports for other accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your autopay was received, but the payment was returned without notice and your closed card account was later shown as delinquent. We understand how confusing this has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the returned payment. Please keep your bank statements showing the withdrawal and return, and a note of the calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cancelled a $5,000.00 vehicle deposit the same day, and that your dispute was denied without your documents being reviewed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the documents you sent. Please keep the deposit receipt, the dealership quote and your cancellation emails, and ask in writing what evidence the decision relied on. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a dispute about refused furniture delivery was reported on your credit file with information you did not agree with, and that you have not received the documentation. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. You have the right to dispute inaccurate information with each credit reporting company, so please file disputes and keep copies of your requests. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you followed a representative's advice on booking a flight to meet the bonus spending requirement, and that the charge was then not counted. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the notes on your account. Please keep the booking confirmation and the date of the call, and ask in writing for the bonus terms that were applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that charges you did not make were credited back after your dispute, but your final statement shows a $310.00 balance you do not recognize and your credit has been affected. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep your dispute results and statements, and ask in writing for a breakdown of the remaining balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your bank shows your $160.00 and $100.00 payments as sent, but the card account does not show them and fees and interest keep growing. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank statements or confirmations showing each payment with its date and amount, and the emails you sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you cannot reach the card company to close your account because the phone numbers do not work and the app needs your card details. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including how you can close the account. Please keep a record of the numbers you tried and when. Any past statement or letter may show the account number and mailing address. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that payments you asked to be applied to your bedroom set promotion were applied elsewhere, despite confirmation from representatives. We understand your concern about the promotion deadline. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including your reallocation requests. Please keep the chat screenshots and call notes, and check your next statements to see how payments are applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
